\subsection{Limitations and Future Work}
Our direct LLM evaluation was constrained to 5--10 puzzles per model tier due to the severe token consumption and monetary cost of multi-minute autoregressive reasoning; while these samples clearly illustrate token exhaustion and state drift, larger test samples would yield tighter confidence bounds.
